message.content: {"caption":"Stacked skill-library counts by training step, with total skills marked by a rising line.","description":"A stacked bar chart with Training Steps on the x-axis (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 150) and Number of Skills on the y-axis, scaled from 0 to 120. Each bar shows skill counts grouped by the legend categories General, Pick, Look, Clean, Heat, Cool, Pick2, and Mistakes, stacked in that order from bottom to top. A black line with yellow star markers shows Total Skills. The printed totals rise at each training step: 55, 60, 66, 71, 77, 83, 88, 94, and 100. The bars and total line both increase overall; General and the task-category segments expand across training. Chart values for the stacked categories are estimated cumulative readings at each segment’s top edge, not the individual segment sizes.
